parts.problem_md:
You have been asked by the secretary of a soccer club to create a website to publicise its results, fixtures and other events.

When the website has been created it has to be published on the internet. You plan to upload it onto the internet using FTP.

Before the website is published it needs to be tested.

**Write **down three different features of the web pages that could be tested.

For each feature, **describe **the method you would use to carry out the test.
parts.solution_md:
Examples of the features that could be tested include:

Any **three **of the following:

**Hyperlinks ****[1 mark]**

- Click each hyperlink to see that it takes the user to the correct web page/part of the web page/website **[1 mark]**

**Form buttons/icons ****[1 mark]**

- Click to see that they carry out the correct task **[1 mark]**

**Text ****[1 mark]**

- Use spellchecker/grammar checker/proofread text to check it makes sense **[1 mark]**

**Images ****[1 mark]**

- Check the images are not pixelated/correct size/correct image **[1 mark]**

**Videos ****[1 mark]**

- Check the videos run correctly/correct video **[1 mark]**

**Sound ****[1 mark]**

- Check the sound file runs correctly/correct sound file linked **[1 mark]**

> **[mark-scheme]**
> - Matched pairs – 1 mark for the feature and 1 mark for the method

parts.problem_md:
Tawara Stores has realised that the number of people shopping for food online has increased over the past few years.

Tawara Stores are also aware that many current websites do not cater for older people. They intend to create a version of their website for this audience.

**Describe **the features of this website to meet the needs of an older audience, giving reasons for your choice of features.
parts.solution_md:
The features of this website to meet the needs of an older audience include:

Any **four **of the following:

- Bold colours/contrasting colours making it easier to read **[1 mark]**
- Larger font sizes/clear font so it is easier for people reading the text **[1 mark]**
- Simple navigation makes it easier to find the products **[1 mark]**
- Larger buttons so they can be easily seen **[1 mark]**
- Interactive screens/buttons/drop down menus to reduce typing **[1 mark]**
- Larger bold heading to make it an easy to read layout **[1 mark]**
